headline: Uni-LaDiR reports shared latent reasoning gains on visual reasoning and simulated manipulation benchmarks
summary: A September 29 preprint introduces Uni-LaDiR, which encodes multimodal teacher reasoning steps in shared latent tokens and generates them with a diffusion reasoner. The authors report a 7.3% relative mean gain over ILVR across four mathematical and logical visual benchmarks and a 6.1% relative success gain over LaST0 across ten simulated RLBench tasks. Results remain author-reported; the manipulation evaluation is simulated, and broader VLM comparisons use methods with different training recipes.
